purpose: Records which URL owns which search intent, for the pairs that have measurably competed for the same queries. SEO Autopilot and any future content work must read this before retargeting a page: two of these pairs were converging on the same head terms and were pulled apart by hand on 2026-08-01. Evidence per pair is in docs/seo/CANNIBALIZATION_AND_MIGRATION_MAP_2026-08-01.md.

spokes.ownsIntent: what drives the price of a website
free site builder versus a commissioned site
what to prepare before commissioning a website
choosing between landing, corporate site, catalogue and shop
choosing a domain and hosting, and who must own them
why an existing site produces no enquiries and what to check

clusters.note: Toshkentda sayt buyurtma qilish returned no volume and is deliberately not claimed by any URL. The four spokes added on 2026-08-01 in the authority sprint are buyer-journey resources, not volume bets: the paid research of the same day returned no measurable volume for their topics, and none of them may ever claim a hub keyword. They exist to answer distinct pre-purchase questions and to route internal authority to the hub. Rejected in the same pass: a development-process article (the hub's own «Ish jarayoni» section owns it), a launch checklist (absorbed into the preparation article), and a standalone technical-brief article (absorbed into the preparation article).
